title: Program Proposers Module
summary: This module provides tools for generating descriptions of datasets, programs, and individual modules, as well as proposing optimized instructions for Language Models. It helps in understanding and refining the components of a DSPy program.

nodes.label: Describe Dataset from Examples
nodes.title: DatasetDescriptor
nodes.description: Analyzes sample data points to identify trends, infer the dataset's task, and generate initial observations about its characteristics.

nodes.label: Describe Dataset with Prior Observations
nodes.title: DatasetDescriptorWithPriorObservations
nodes.description: Extends or completes existing dataset observations by analyzing new examples, inferring the task, and adding further insights.

nodes.label: Summarize Dataset Observations
nodes.title: ObservationSummarizer
nodes.description: Condenses a series of detailed dataset observations into a concise 2-3 sentence summary, highlighting key insights.

nodes.label: Describe Program Task & Logic
nodes.title: DescribeProgram
nodes.description: Analyzes a program's pseudocode and an execution example to articulate its intended task and the underlying logic for solving it.

nodes.label: Describe Module's Role in Program
nodes.title: DescribeModule
nodes.description: Explains the specific function and contribution of a designated module within a larger program, given the program's overall description.

nodes.label: Format Instruction History
nodes.title: create_instruction_set_history_string
nodes.description: Processes program trial logs to extract, deduplicate, and format the instruction sets of top-performing programs into a readable historical string.

nodes.label: Generate LM Instruction
nodes.title: GenerateSingleModuleInstruction
nodes.description: Crafts an optimized instruction for a Language Model, leveraging dataset descriptions, program details, module roles, task demonstrations, and historical instruction performance.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Generative Components
groups.description: Components responsible for generating new content such as summaries, descriptions, or instructions.

groups.label: Analytical Utilities
groups.title: Analytical Utilities
groups.description: Utility functions that process and analyze data to prepare it for other components.
